//: Capability manifest for grid/1 — keen-pure-admin. See accent-grid.map.json for the container model. grid/1 renders `<div class="pc-row …">` with no-gutter/same-height/justify/valign modifiers + a class passthrough + inner_block slot. Neutral `justify` maps to keen's `align` prop (center|end|between|around); neutral `valign` maps to keen's `valign` prop (top|middle|bottom|stretch). Keen has no gap prop — gap is out of scope here.
